create.name: Sara Davidson Flanders
create.bio:
Sara Davidson Flanders took up yoga and meditation in the early 1990s and has been teaching since 1997. She is a certified Anusara Yoga teacher, and since 2018 she has been an authorised teacher of Neelakantha Meditation within Blue Throat Yoga, the school of Paul Muller-Ortega devoted to the non-dual Śākta-Śaiva Tantric tradition. Over many years she has helped that school as a mentor to new meditators and to trainee meditation teachers, as part of its transcription team, and as a co-teacher of its foundational course of text study.

In Providence, Rhode Island, she owns Full Radiance Yoga, a studio where every class is offered on a pay-what-you-can basis and where BIPoC and LGBTQIA+ students and teachers are made especially welcome. Her own classes pair close attention to alignment and the mechanics of each pose with the philosophy behind the practice, so that physical work becomes a doorway to a wider sense of awareness. She also gives one-to-one instruction in Neelakantha Meditation, leads seasonal workshops such as a New Year's Eve practice of ritual, chant and breath, and teaches retreats at Kripalu with fellow Anusara teacher Tasha Judson.

courses.title: The Body as Gateway: Exploring the Tantra of Anusara Yoga
courses.description: A two-night residential weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, co-led with Tasha Judson. Anusara alignment work is joined with the ideas of non-dual Śākta-Śaiva Tantra, alongside mantra, breathwork, contemplation and meditation. Open to sincere students at any level.

courses.title: Learning Neelakantha Meditation
courses.description: Personal instruction in Neelakantha Meditation, an effortless daily practice from the Tantric yoga tradition, taught over two sessions with a follow-up meeting two weeks later. Students then have ongoing access to recorded teachings, support calls, group sittings and translated source texts.

courses.title: Heart Centered Yoga classes
courses.description: Sara's weekly studio classes in Providence bring precise alignment together with non-dual yoga philosophy, using specific actions in each pose to sharpen awareness and move energy through the body. Suitable for newcomers and for experienced students who want to go deeper.
courses.price: $5–$30 USD per class (pay what you can)

courses.title: New Year's Eve Playshop
courses.description: An annual two-hour afternoon session at Full Radiance Yoga to close the year. A flowing practice is woven with ritual, chanting, breathwork, meditation and candlelight, as a way to let the old year go and set intentions for the new one.
